answer: The voyage receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 34 aliases trips the duplicate check at the onyx gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, thus the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. A farm of 128 pays that 116 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
